segments.sn14.35:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“yo, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātuṃ abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati.
segments.sn14.35:1.3: Yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
segments.sn14.35:1.4: Yo āpodhātuṃ abhinandati … pe … yo tejodhātuṃ … yo vāyodhātuṃ abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati.
segments.sn14.35:1.7: Yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi”.
segments.sn14.35:2.1: “Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātuṃ nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati.
segments.sn14.35:2.2: Yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
segments.sn14.35:2.3: Yo āpodhātuṃ … pe … yo tejodhātuṃ … yo vāyodhātuṃ nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati.
segments.sn14.35:2.6: Yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmī”ti.

lines: Catusaccamevāti cattāri saccāni samāhaṭāni catusaccanti tesaṃ ekajjhaṃ gahaṇaṃ, niyamo pana tabbinimuttassa paramatthassa abhāvato.
